segments.name: Guardian Laboratories
segments.description: Makes specialty cosmetic, personal care and sexual wellness ingredients, plus pharmaceuticals and medical lubricants, for manufacturers and marketers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business under one operating segment, which is also its reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and wholesalers pay the company for ingredients and pharmaceuticals, which they buy outright for resale to end customers.
revenueModel.evidence: These distributors purchase products outright from the Company and provide the main marketing and sales functions for these products on behalf of the Company.
